option_relations.rationale: Statin-induced rhabdomyolysis can cause acute tubular necrosis. The option describes a cause-effect relationship where rhabdomyolysis leads to ATN.
Relugolix is not mentioned in the vignette as a medication the patient was taking, nor is it a known cause of rhabdomyolysis in this context.
Rhabdomyolysis-induced acute kidney injury is clinically equivalent to acute tubular necrosis in this context, as ATN is the primary form of AKI caused by rhabdomyolysis.

Prolonged immobility can cause rhabdomyolysis, which in turn can lead to acute tubular necrosis. The option describes a cause-effect relationship where immobility leads to rhabdomyolysis, which then leads to ATN.
